grep -rn "decode_escapes\|_single_quote_escapes\|_double_quote_escapes\|unicode-escape" /workspace --include='*.py' ; echo ---; python -c "import dotenv, inspect, dotenv.parser as p; print(dotenv.__file__)" 2>&1; pip show python-dotenv 2>&1 | head -10
cd /workspace && ls -laR . | head -80; echo ---; find / -maxdepth 4 -name '*dotenv*' -not -path '/proc/*' -not -path '/sys/*' 2>/dev/null | head -20
cd /workspace && cat dotenv/version.py dotenv/variables.py; echo "=====INIT====="; cat dotenv/__init__.py
cd /workspace && python -m unittest discover -s tests -v 2>&1 | tail -30

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io, re
from dotenv.parser import (parse_stream, decode_escapes, _double_quote_escapes,
                           _single_quote_escapes)

cases = [
    r'''X="line\nnext"''',
    r'''X="tab\there"''',
    r'''X="cr\rhere"''',
    r'''X="a\bb\fc\ad\ve"''',
    r'''X="back\\slash"''',
    r'''X="quote\'inside"''',
    r'''X="quote\"inside"''',
    r'''X="unknown\q\$\0\x41\u0041"''',
    r'''X="no\nescape in double?"''',
    r"X='line\nnext'",
    r"X='quote\'inside'",
    r"X='quote\"inside'",
    r"X='back\\slash'",
    r"X='unknown\q\$'",
    r'''X=""''',
    r"X=''",
    r'''X=un\nquoted''',
    r'''X="trailing spaces   "''',
    r"""X='single quoted # not comment'""",
    r'''X="double quoted # not comment"''',
    r'''X=unquoted # comment''',
]
for line in cases:
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(line + "\n")))
    r = rows[0]
    print(f"{line!r:45} error={r.error!s:5} key={r.key!r:5} value={r.value!r}")

print("\n--- regex.sub simulation (the missing line) ---")
for rx, name in [(_double_quote_escapes,'double'),(_single_quote_escapes,'single')]:
    for raw in [r'\\', r"\'", r'\"', r'\a', r'\b', r'\f', r'\n', r'\r', r'\t', r'\v', r'\q', r'\$', r'\0', r'\x41', r'\u0041']:
        if rx.fullmatch(raw):
            print(f"{name:6} recognizes {raw!r} -> {rx.sub(lambda m: __import__('codecs').decode(m.group(0),'unicode-escape'), raw)!r}")
        else:
            print(f"{name:6} passes through {raw!r} unchanged")
EOF
